title: Normalized projective-line trace presentation before choosing its trace
statement: Let l be prime, X,S Noetherian schemes with the recorded derived localizations, f:X→S and e:X≅P1(S) with e.hom≫q=f, and suppose l is a unit on S. There is a Presentation p over ULift(Q_l) with precisely model e. Its actual unit/Chern map model.bq is invertible, its twisted-unit/trace and Chern/trace composites have finite evaluations zero and identity respectively, and completed scalar restriction is bijective on Hom(Rc(completedLine(X)[2]),completedUnit(S)). This asserts the normalized comparisons and completeness needed for lifting, but chooses no completed trace and asserts no diagonal integral.

proof.text: Construct normalized comparison data p with the prescribed projective-line model, without choosing a completed trace.

The finite evaluations of bq are invertible. Apply the joint conservativity already included in p.base.calculus to obtain IsIso bq. Identify the twisted unit and Chern adjunct with the two twisted splitting inclusions.

Expand Model.trace. Cancel the projection comparison with its inverse and combine the functor maps of bq and its inverse. The biproduct identities inl≫snd=0 and inr≫snd=1 give the system trace composites zero and identity. The second identity also cancels b.inv≫b.hom. Apply each exact evaluation functor to these global equations.
The complete-object restriction theorem supplies bijectivity on the specified completed Hom set. Combine it with p, its model equality, invertible splitting and evaluated zero/identity equations.

theorem exists_diagonalTracePresentation (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian X]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (m : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hm : m.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    ∃ p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f,
      p.model.model = m ∧
      ∃ hs : IsIso (p.model.bq l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))),
        letI := hs
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          (SpTowerShriek.Ev l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S n).map
            (p.model.twistedUnit l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) ≫
              p.model.trace l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))) = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          (SpTowerShriek.Ev l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S n).map
            (p.model.chernAdjoint l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) ≫
              p.model.trace l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))) =
                𝟙 ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S n).obj
                  (SpTowerClasses.unit S (SpTowerClasses.Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S)))) ∧
        Function.Bijective (fun t : p.Rc.R.obj ((completedLine l X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ⟶
            completedUnit l S ↦ (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).map t)
